models.note: Official BF16 safetensors of Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking, the complete published file set at the pinned revision: 16 safetensors shards plus the shard index, config.json, generation_config.json, chat_template.json, preprocessor_config.json, tokenizer_config.json, vocab.json, merges.txt, README.md and .gitattributes. The BF16 twin of qwen3-omni-30b-a3b-thinking-gguf-q4km and the serving core of the speech-aware-evidence-acquisition NPU/vLLM port (owner decision 9.4, 2026-10-28: approved; design doc studies/speech-aware-evidence-acquisition/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-28-npu-vllm-port-design.md). The study's port model fragment configs/model/bf16-thinking-vllm-slurp-module-fold-b-seq4-len24k-budget3072-max4096-port-v1.json names this entry as its model_lock_key and resolves local_subdir under its model_materialization_root (the data root on the Ascend hosts). vLLM reads 24 of the 26 files; README.md and .gitattributes are governed for byte closure with the published revision only. Declared differences from the historical llama.cpp runs (design doc section 8): BF16 weights and BF16 KV instead of Q4_K_M and q8_0 KV, the server's own audio tower over raw audio instead of mmproj packets, vLLM sampling and kernels.
models.research_role: Frozen serving core (the answering model) of the speech-aware study's NPU/vLLM port cells: the same model and thinking mode as the historical Q4_K_M Thinking core, served at BF16 by vLLM-Ascend.
models.claim_limit: Port runs on these bytes are not bit-comparable with the historical llama.cpp Q4_K_M runs (design doc section 8). A number measured on them is a port measurement carrying the declared differences, never on its own a reproduction of a historical number.

models.note: vLLM serving view of nv-community/omni-embed-nemotron-3b (the control arm of the encoder ladder: the historical retrieval core, now causal), built for the speech-aware-evidence-acquisition NPU/vLLM port (owner decision 9.4, 2026-10-28: approved; design doc studies/speech-aware-evidence-acquisition/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-28-npu-vllm-port-design.md section 6.1). It differs from its source in exactly the declared ways the receipt lists: every tensor name prefixed 'thinker.' with the tensor data regions byte-identical (data SHA-256 recorded on both sides; model-00001-of-00002.safetensors 1148 tensors, model-00002-of-00002.safetensors 294 tensors); config.json rewrapped as thinker_config of a qwen2_5_omni config (Qwen2_5OmniForConditionalGeneration, auto_map dropped, no remote code); chat_template.jinja = the source's additional_chat_templates/sentence_transformers.jinja; attention causal (owner decision 2026-10-28). Recipe: MEAN pooling, L2-normalised, 2048 dims, prompts 'query: ' / 'passage: '. Identity is the receipt hash in revision; the pooling client refuses a view whose receipt differs from its pin. The receipt records the absolute source_dir, so a rebuild reproduces the same receipt bytes only from a source at that same absolute path.
models.research_role: Frozen tool-level retrieval encoder (encode-only) served by vLLM for the port's regenerated retrieval vectors; final answer authority stays with the frozen core.
models.claim_limit: Vectors from this view are causal and come from different kernels than the historical sealed vectors; comparison with history is by ranking agreement only (design doc section 6.2).
